messages.subject: 10 Simple Rules for Effective Statistical Practice

messages.body_plain:
Statisticians Compile List of 10 Simple Rules for Effective Statistical Practice

 <http://journals.plos.org/ploscompbiol/article?id=10.1371%2Fjournal.pcbi.1004961>
Credit: PLOS

Statistics may be everywhere, but they aren't always understood, calculated, or communicated effectively. After a suggestion from the ASA, a group of leading statisticians penned "Ten Simple Rules for Effective Statistical Practice" to help researchers avoid pitfalls of misrepresenting data or formulating hypotheses based on faulty statistical reasoning.

The list was recently published in the journal Computational Biology. <http://journals.plos.org/ploscompbiol/article?id=10.1371%2Fjournal.pcbi.1004961> Share it with colleagues!

http://journals.plos.org/ploscompbiol/article?id=10.1371%2Fjournal.pcbi.1004961#sec011

--

messages.body_plain:
Zanimivo branje, hvala lepa. Spodaj pa posredujem še svež članek izpod peresa Zuurja in Ienove, ki je, kot je za njiju že v navadi, zelo praktičen. Verjamem, da bo marsikdo našel kak zanimiv košček tudi zase. Če kdo nima dostopa do PDF-ja, me lahko kontaktira "off-list".

Zuur, A. F., & Ieno, E. N. (2016). A protocol for conducting and presenting results of regression-type analyses. Methods in Ecology and Evolution, 7(6), 636–645. http://doi.org/10.1111/2041-210X.12577

lp,
Roman

messages.subject: konferenca v Budimpešti, delavnice s celega spektra znanj (3.9.2016)
messages.subject_clean: konferenca v Budimpešti, delavnice s celega spektra znanj (3.9.2016)
messages.body_plain:
Pozdravljeni,

kolegi z Madžarske organizirajo "satuRday" konferenco. Gre za enodneven dogodek, ki bo bogat s predavanj in delavnicami. Tokrat se obetajo delavnice iz prikazovanja podatkov, manipulacije s podatki, strojnega učenja, Shiny deske, strganje podatkov s spleta in več. Delavnice vodijo znani R razvijalci s celega sveta. Če koga zanima več, si lahko prebere na tej spletni strani <http://blog.rapporter.net/2016/06/satrday-conference-in-september-2016-at.html>. Cena participacije je simbolna iz znača cca 10-20 €.

lp,
Roman

--
